basic_details.job_title: Chandigarh Sports Council Assistant Female Hockey Coach Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Chandigarh Sports Council has invited applications for 1 post of Assistant Female Hockey Coach at the Khelo India State Centre of Excellence (KISCE), Chandigarh. The post is purely on contract under the Khelo India Scheme, run jointly with the Sports Authority of India. Applications in the prescribed format must be submitted at the O/o Secretary, Chandigarh Sports Council, Hockey Stadium, Sports Complex, Sector-42, Chandigarh. The last date for receipt is 2 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

Proof of date of birth: The council accepts only the date of birth in the Matriculation or Secondary School Leaving Certificate, or in a certificate recognized by an Indian University as equivalent to Matriculation. It also accepts an extract from a Register of Matriculates kept by a University, certified by the proper authority of the University, or the Higher Secondary or an equivalent examination certificate. Horoscopes, affidavits, birth extracts from the Municipal Corporation, service records and the like will not be accepted. Remuneration: Rs 40000-60000. content_sections.heading: About KISCE Chandigarh
content_sections.text: The Chandigarh Sports Council is an autonomous organisation under the administrative control of the Sports Department, Chandigarh Administration, with its head office at Sports Complex, Sector-42, Chandigarh. In partnership with SAI, the council has set up the Khelo India State Centre of Excellence (KISCE) in Chandigarh to train young and elite athletes in various disciplines. The centre falls under the State Level Khelo India Centre (SLKIC) vertical of the Khelo India Scheme, which provides financial support for sports science back-up and for engaging coaches and support staff.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Submit the application in the prescribed Performa attached at Annexure A at this office: O/o The Secretary, Chandigarh Sports Council, Hockey Stadium, Sports Complex, Sector-42, Chandigarh. It must be complete in every respect, in line with the eligibility criteria and the technical selection criteria. Applications must be received on or before 2 November 2026 (05:00 PM). Applications received after the due date will be rejected outright. The notice does not mention the mode of sending (by post or by hand) or anything to write on the envelope. From 17 October 2026, the eligibility criteria and the technical selection criteria can be downloaded from www.sportsdeptt.chd.gov.in and http://chdpr.gov.in. The council's letterhead gives the phone/fax number 0172-2646444 and the email [email protected] . For further updates, the notice asks candidates to visit these two websites regularly. The Annexure A application format asks for: A recent photograph and the post applied for Name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, nationality, postal address, contact number and e-mail address Educational qualifications from Matriculation onwards: certificate/degree, subject, institute/university, year of passing and percentage/CPGA Work experience: organisation/institute, period from–to, nature of work, remarks and total experience in months Sports participation at international level and at national level (event and position) A signed declaration with place and date. The declaration says the candidature is liable to be cancelled or rejected at any stage if any information is false, incorrect or does not meet the eligibility criteria. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists 1 post of Assistant Female Hockey Coach under Coaching Staff. The council calls this figure indicative: the number of vacancies and the place of deployment can be varied as per workload. Essential qualification: Graduate with Diploma in Coaching from SAI, NS NIS or from any other recognized Indian/Foreign University OR Olympic/International Participation OR Dronacharya Awardee. Age limit: The maximum age shall not be more than 40 years on the last date of receipt of application (2 November 2026). Proof of date of birth: The council accepts only the date of birth in the Matriculation or Secondary School Leaving Certificate, or in a certificate recognized by an Indian University as equivalent to Matriculation. It also accepts an extract from a Register of Matriculates kept by a University, certified by the proper authority of the University, or the Higher Secondary or an equivalent examination certificate. Horoscopes, affidavits, birth extracts from the Municipal Corporation, service records and the like will not be accepted. Remuneration: Rs 40000-60000. Income tax or any other tax will be deducted at source under the prevailing rules, and the Chandigarh Sports Council will issue TDS/Service Tax Certificates, as applicable. Allowances: No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. Other facilities such as DA, accommodation, residential phone, conveyance transport, personal staff, medical reimbursement, HRA and LTC are not admissible. If the appointee has to go outstation from the place of posting on official tour, TA/DA will be paid as admissible under the rules. Leave: 30 days of leave in a calendar year on a pro-rata basis. No remuneration is paid for absence beyond 30 days in a year. Unused leave lapses and is not carried forward to the next calendar year. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility criteria and technical selection criteria for the post.

content_sections.heading: KISCE Chandigarh Assistant Female Hockey Coach Job Description
content_sections.text: The Assistant Coach will assist the Head Coach to perform his/her duty efficiently and smoothly. Under performance management, the Assistant Coach helps the Head Coach with: Assessing strengths and weaknesses in an athlete's performance and identifying areas for further development Adapting to the needs and interests of group or individual trainees Communicating instructions and commands using clear, simple language Encouraging participants to gain and develop skills, knowledge and techniques Ensuring that trainees train and perform to a high standard of health and safety at all times Inspiring confidence and self-belief Developing knowledge and understanding of fitness, injury, sports psychology, Nutrition and Sports Science Working with IT-based resources to monitor and measure performance Acting as a role model, gaining the respect and trust of the people Liaising with other partners in performance management, such as Coaches, Physiotherapists, Doctors and Nutritionists Working to a high legal and ethical standard at all times, particularly on child safeguarding, gender equality and health and safety requirements, including Protection from sexual harassment Planning and administration duties: Producing personalized training programmes Maintaining records of trainees' performance Coordinating trainees' attendance at meetings and other sports events Planning and running programmes of activities for groups and individuals Co-coordinating with other coaches for transporting trainees to and from training sessions and sports events Seeking and applying for sponsorship agreements by engaging all stakeholders Finding appropriate competitions for participants Planning work schedule in consultation with other coaches

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed Performa (Annexure A) Self-attested copies of supporting documents, such as the Educational qualification, Experience Certificate and Sports Achievement Certificate Latest passport size photograph

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The council will scrutinise and shortlist the applications on the basis of relevant experience and the job description. Eligible candidates will be called for an interview at their own cost. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview. The notice does not give an interview date. Owing to its requirements, the Chandigarh Sports Council may draw up a list of panels valid for one year, and it reserves the right to cancel the panel without giving any reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KISCE Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Assistant Female Hockey Coach. The notice calls this figure indicative and says it can be varied as per workload.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KISCE Chandigarh Assistant Female Hockey Coach post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 2 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Applications received after the due date will be rejected outright.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Assistant Female Hockey Coach post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate with Diploma in Coaching from SAI, NS NIS or any other recognized Indian/Foreign University. Olympic/International Participation or being a Dronacharya Awardee also qualifies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KISCE Chandigarh Assistant Female Hockey Coach post?
faq.answer: The maximum age shall not be more than 40 years on the last date of receipt of application, which is 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the KISCE Chandigarh Assistant Female Hockey Coach?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs 40000-60000. Tax is deducted at source, and DA, accommodation, HRA, LTC, medical reimbursement and similar facilities are not admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the KISCE Chandigarh Assistant Female Hockey Coach post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure A application format and attach self-attested educational, experience and sports achievement certificates and a latest passport size photograph. Submit it at the O/o Secretary, Chandigarh Sports Council, Hockey Stadium, Sports Complex, Sector-42, Chandigarh, by 2 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Female Hockey Coach post?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and shortlisted on the basis of relevant experience and the job description, and eligible candidates are called for an interview at their own cost.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KISCE Chandigarh Assistant Female Hockey Coach job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract and gives no right to claim permanent employment. It can be extended year to year, or until Khelo India extends the project/scheme, whichever is earlier, depending on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is admissible for the interview, or for joining the assignment or completing it. TA/DA is paid under the rules only for official tours outstation from the place of posting.

faq.question: Q10. How much leave does the KISCE Chandigarh Assistant Female Hockey Coach get?
faq.answer: Selected candidates get 30 days of leave in a calendar year on a pro-rata basis. Unused leave lapses, and no remuneration is paid for absence beyond 30 days.
